title: Coverage of frequency prefixes
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let a trace be a finite list of estimate records, let $J$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, and let $[4mfrequencies[0m$ be a finite family of subsets of those coordinates. The trace covers this family at $J$ if, for every member of the family, it contains a record whose coordinate set is $J$ and whose frequency prefix is that member.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of estimate records
